violation_type.title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))
violation_type.short_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer
violation_type.typical_finding: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.

finding_variants.text: A table manufactured for use with safety straps does not have safety straps on it. Children were observed at the table without being strapped in.
The seats in the kidney shaped table in the toddler classroom are not equipped with safety straps.

An infant sitting at a kidney table did not have the safety straps fastened.
Observed two infants sitting in high chairs that were not strapped into the seat. This was corrected when both infants were strapped into the seat.
Two students were observed seated in highchairs without the required straps.
